data.name: Carbex
data.description: Carbex GmbH is a German biochar producer based in Dischingen, Baden-Württemberg, founded in 2021. The company manufactures a range of EBC-certified biochar products for agriculture, livestock, construction, and filtration, and is listed as a member of the German biochar producer ecosystem. Its corporate purpose includes biochar R&D, production, trade, and emissions trading.
